intro: Ivory Coast has a lagoon-lined coast, rainforest in the south and savanna in the north.

chapters.title: Lagoons to savanna
text: Abidjan sits on the Ébrié Lagoon. Taï National Park protects one of the last large rainforests in West Africa, home to chimpanzees that use stones as tools. The Man mountains rise in the west, and Mount Nimba is the highest point.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The south is hot and wet; the north is drier.

keyTerms.meaning: Shallow water separated from the sea by a sandbar.
